name: brb-claude-code
description: BRB — Be Right Back. Pause and resume Claude Code sessions with structured, local checkpoints.
author: g4lb <galevgi@gmail.com>

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs build/tests/unit build/tests/integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs build/tests/unit
scripts.validate:plugin: claude plugin validate . --strict && claude plugin validate plugin --strict
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run verify:dist
